commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
90+4' Javi Lopez (Alaves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+1' Valery (Girona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' The attendance for today's match is 11812.
86' Crossbar! Ruben Duarte (Alaves) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
85' Javi Lopez (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
84' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
82' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Juanpe (Girona) coming on for David Lopez.
79' Michel prepares a substitution. Yan Couto is replaced by Arnau Martinez (Girona).
78' The substitution is prepared. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonio Blanco.
78' Valery (Girona) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
76' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
75' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Alaves win a corner.
73' Here is a change. Andoni Gorosabel is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Alex Sola (Alaves).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Kike Garcia (Alaves) is replacing Samu Omorodion.
73' The substitution has been made. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) has replaced Ivan Martin.

72' Pablo Torre (Girona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Antonio Sivera is alert and denies him with a nice save. Corner kick. Girona will have an opportunity.
68' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
67' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
66' Aleix Garcia (Girona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

66' Yan Couto (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' Substitution. Savio did his best and is replaced by Valery (Girona).
64' Michel has decided to substitute Portu and he is replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
64' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Artem Dovbyk (Girona) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
61' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Jon Guridi will be replaced by Ianis Hagi (Alaves).
61' Substitution. Luis Rioja will be replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).

61' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
59' 3 - 0 GOAL! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Antonio Sivera.
59' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
58' Javi Lopez (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Francisco Maeso interrupted the game to signal a free kick. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Girona.
57' Ander Guevara (Alaves) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post.
56' Yan Couto (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
55' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.

53' Luis Rioja (Alaves) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
52' What a chance that is! Rafa Marin (Alaves) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
52' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul after Portu (Girona) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
48' Luis Rioja (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! Portu (Girona) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 2:0.
41' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
40' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
39' What was Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
39' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Luis Rioja (Alaves) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
35' Aleix Garcia (Girona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francisco Maeso stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
35' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
33' The possession of the ball – 72:28.
31' Aleix Garcia (Girona) is flagged for offside.
31' The resulting corner from Aleix Garcia (Girona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
31' Yan Couto (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Girona will take a corner kick.
30' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Paulo Gazzaniga.
29' Yan Couto (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Portu (Girona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

23' 1 - 0 GOAL! Yan Couto fired in an amazing shot. The goalkeeper showed his agility and punched the ball away, but only deflected it into the path of Artem Dovbyk (Girona) and his close-range header went straight into the roof of the net. He makes it 1:0.
21' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) is adjudged offside.
20' Referee Francisco Maeso sees the trip by Daley Blind (Girona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
18' Savio (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
13' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Girona take a short corner kick.

9' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' Savio (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yan Couto (Girona).
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso was nominated as the referee for this game.
